decision.reason: The autonomous engine is faster and resolves the modeled illuminant more accurately, with equivalent Bayer detail, but the preserving policy still has a disadvantage on clipped neutral model fields. HL1 neutralizes these fields at the expense of some coloured lights and edge gradients; it is rejected as default. Overall superiority is not established.
decision.installed_improvement: mat2 keeps final matrix coefficients, products and sums in f64 and rounds the output once to fp32. No new highlight policy or sensor threshold is installed.
decision.next_quality_work: Confidence-aware local chromaticity estimation for highlights, with independently established sensor clipping levels, boundaries and a new holdout. Physical profile accuracy still requires measured target captures.

models: X-T5 compatibility coefficients on Bayer CFA
scope.actual_xtrans_in_integration: X-T5 lossy 14 bit RAF and calibration-only DNG
scope.legacy_coverage_limit: Legacy decoder admits D750/D40 Bayer and TrueRenderer Synthetic DNG only. The D800 and X-T5 synthetic coefficients are not evidence that legacy can decode those actual cameras.

protocol_frozen_before_measurements.name: TR-renderer-duel-v1
protocol_frozen_before_measurements.scope: Compare independent and legacy TrueRenderer; D40 explicitly excluded by user; no new camera support
protocol_frozen_before_measurements.color: Known RGB->XYZ->camera forward model with fixed matrices and Bradford source whites, quantized sensor values; measured camera accuracy remains unknown
protocol_frozen_before_measurements.detail: Shared synthetic truth for smooth signals, edges, fine achromatic and independent-color textures; all Bayer phases; measured-source and interpolation errors separated
protocol_frozen_before_measurements.highlights: Separate exact unclipped near-white colors and clipped neutral/colored fields; clipping does not have a unique inverse
protocol_frozen_before_measurements.performance: Full broker decode only, 3 warmups and 30 alternating repetitions per engine on 3 existing D750 originals; hash and analysis outside timed span. Both XPC slots; OS cache retained. Record all times, median and p95, exact repeatability
protocol_frozen_before_measurements.retirement_criteria: No unsupported replacement on selected cameras (D40 excluded), no material regression on tested unambiguous detail/color; assess clipped neutral cases separately before retirement. No assertion of physical camera accuracy without measured targets. Persistent legacy recipes require explicit handling, no silent reinterpretation.

limitations: No calibrated camera target captures are available. Forward and inverse models reuse compatibility coefficients; mathematical consistency is not physical colour fidelity.
Clipped channels have no unique inverse; neither preservation nor neutral estimation recovers arbitrary original chromaticity.

Validation colours and scenes differ from the first set; all matrices remain the same model family. HL1 validation is consumed and must not be claimed as an independent gate for a modified highlight candidate.
Final mat2 reruns are regression checks on the existing duel corpus. Its independent numerical precision reference uses 110-digit Decimal calculations.
Timing uses warm OS caches on one Mac. Output hashing, analysis and image/report writes are outside the timed span. No cold-start, thermal control or whole-machine RSS qualification.
RGB float values can be negative or exceed one; main Delta E admits only the documented unclipped Lab domain. Linear errors retain all other patches.
Photographs, original paths, galleries, databases, backups, toolchains and app bundles remain private and are not included in this report.
